description: French VAT franchise en base 2026 (F21746): exempt while last year's turnover is at most 85,000 EUR (sales, lodging) or 37,500 EUR (services); VAT due immediately above 93,500 / 41,250 EUR this year, or from next 1 January between the two. The single 25,000 EUR threshold plan was abandoned. Rates 20/10/5.5/2.1%. France, as of 2026-11-21 (service-public.fr and BOFiP). General information and estimates only; no personalised advice, bookkeeping or filing.
